segments.text:
LAstly, Let us consider, what may be useful
to support and quiet our hearts under
doubtful Providences, when our dear concernments
hang in a doubtful suspence before us, and we
know not which way the Providence of God will
cast and determine them.

Now the best hearts are apt to grow solicitous
and pensive, distracted with thoughtfulness
about the event and issue. To relieve and settle
us in this case, the following Considerations are
very useful.
